metadata.description: Bett3r internal AI development tooling: the project-agnostic vertical-slice workflow plus the PV3 DDD framework skills.

plugins.name: bett3r-ai-workflow
plugins.description: Vertical-slice, dual-gated development flow: grill the design, slice it (tracer bullet first), drive each slice to green with executor + verifier + test loop, commit per slice, land the PR as system of record. Project-agnostic — reads the host repo's conventions at runtime.

plugins.name: bett3r-pv3-ai-skills
plugins.description: PV3 DDD framework skills: generate designed artifacts' mechanical half from the ESAS design graph, then fill schemas, aggregates, policies, read models and tests by hand, with a ddd-patterns reference. Reads each host repo's packages/paths from .esas.config.json.

plugins.name: bett3r-knowledge-store
plugins.description: Knowledge-store capture overlay for the flow: two hooks attach to the two moments worth recording — artifacts are captured synchronously right before `git worktree remove` destroys them, and a freshly-opened PR is captured and queued for extraction, detached. The base flow plugin stays store-agnostic; a repo with no executable `.knowledge-store/capture` is byte-for-byte unaffected.
